slides.title: CANNABIS AND SMOKING ARE ON A COLLISION COURSE
slides.text: Since legal cannabis began, the broadest range of product options and the most expert customer service have centered on smokables. But carcinogens and lung damage should not be the price of entry for the benefits of cannabis. The vast majority of cannabis consumers don't want to "get high"; they want to use cannabis to address specific conditions. As legalization expands, more and more consumers want non- smokable, socially dosed, discreet formats.

slides.title: EDIBLES ARE THE FUTURE
slides.text: But edibles have been highly problematic. The edibles category is cluttered with cheaply made, unpredictable, bad-tasting product. Most edibles don't offer specific therapeutic effects and they take far too long to activate. (It's no coincidence that so many people have nightmare stories about edibles.) Consumers need healthier, more effective options to meet their increasingly specific needs.

slides.title: SOLVING THE PROBLEM WITH EDIBLES OPENS UP A WHOLE NEW WORLD
slides.text: Our company is pioneering ways to deliver NON- SMOKABLE controlled doses of cannabis and plant medicines in safe, discreet and user-friendly formats that enable cannabis to become a wellness tool and a performance-enhancing "supplement." 1 PRODUCTS THAT TASTE GREAT 2 DELIVER SPECIFIC EFFECTS 3 ACTIVATE IN RECORD TIME

slides.title: MEET FUNCTIONAL CANNABIS
slides.text: The existing cannabis market was designed for stoners. There is a vast untapped segment of people who are interested in health and wellness, but have yet to discover cannabis as a crucial tool in their self-care routine. 1906 straddles the cannabis market and the overall health and wellness market by creating finely tuned formulas that enhance the most important parts of high-functioning adults' lives - sleep, sex, energy, cognitive focus, relaxation, and mood.

slides.title: FUTURE CONSUMERS ARE AT OUR DOOR
slides.text: New consumers want what we're making, according to an extensive survey we commissioned with the Harris Poll. 72% ARE WOMEN 33% ARE BOOMERS 54% DO NOT CURRENTLY USE CANNABIS 63% ARE INTERESTED IN EDIBLES

slides.title: FUNCTIONAL CANNABIS IS BECOMING MAINSTREAM
slides.text: A recent survey tells us that the vast majority of adults (3 out of 4) are interested in using cannabis as medicine. Modern life ask a lot of us, and right now, many people turn to pharmaceuticals and alcohol for help. The majority of people would prefer a plant-based alternative, and cannabis is very promising. Even among people who already use cannabis, most cannabis consumers are actually using cannabis to treat pain, anxiety, or sleep problems, rather than "get high."
